entries.title: Blitz renders into a layer-shell bar with compositor blur, and the dock hover animates with zero idle frames
entries.lede: The go/no-go item for the whole program passed with no fallback. A Dioxus document draws into a top-anchored layer surface through one shared GPU renderer; the bar reserves its 32 px, the compositor blurs what is behind it, a hover sweep across twelve dock icons renders every frame in about a millisecond, and five seconds of idle produce no frames at all. Two surfaces in one process cost 2 MB more than one. Run in a nested virtual KWin because the session was locked.
notes: Dock sweep: 69 frames for 70 callbacks, 0.92 ms median, 1.25 ms p95 against a 16.7 ms budget; idle: 0 frames, 0 commits.
Blur: pixel variance inside the bar dropped from 3306 to 0.56.
Fractional scale 1.5 and 1.7 map buffer to screen pixel for pixel; a 2-logical-px checker measures 3 px at 1.5.
NVIDIA on Vulkan works; the AMD iGPU and the GL backend do not present on this machine.

entries.title: A custom-painted widget draws into its own GPU texture inside a Blitz document
entries.lede: The path the terminal, video player and PDF viewer will use: a Rust widget owns a wgpu texture, renders into it each frame, and Blitz composites it as an image. Redraw requests stop after the widget says it is idle. The headless render-to-PNG path and its snapshot test (the CI gate for every surface) also work.
notes: Rendered on the RTX 5070 Ti through Vulkan, offscreen; the CPU path leaves the widget transparent by design.
Snapshot tolerance: at most 2 per channel and 0.1 % of pixels; a deliberate colour change was rejected at 8.2 %.

entries.title: Blur, fractional scale and popups work against KWin from a bare client
entries.lede: Hand-written Wayland protocol handlers (the ones smithay-client-toolkit 0.20 lacks): the compositor advertises blur and honours a region; fractional scale reports this display's real 1.7; an xdg_popup child of a layer surface positions itself with the compositor's own constraint adjustment, and a nested submenu positions relative to it.
notes: Popup 1 configured at (0,28) 180x110 after KWin slid it on-screen; popup 2 at (164,13) 160x90.
24 tests: rounded-strip regions against a raster oracle, positioner tables, scale rounding.
No screenshot: the capture tool returned transparent images from that run; fixed for the next spike.

entries.title: cosmic-comp runs nested inside the KDE session with every protocol we need
entries.lede: One script starts a nested COSMIC compositor as a window, records its socket, and lists its globals. It advertises layer-shell v5, background blur, fractional scale, viewporter, COSMIC toplevel and workspace protocols, and text-input v3. ghostty runs inside it; stopping it leaves the host untouched.
notes: Works on the NVIDIA path directly; the AMD fallback was not needed.
Frosted glass is set through com.system76.CosmicTheme.{Dark,Light}/v2/frosted; 1.8.0 reads only v2.

entries.title: Sixteen Blitz CSS probes settle what the design system may use
entries.lede: Each probe renders a tiny document headlessly and checks pixels. Transitions, keyframes, custom properties, animation restart, SVG currentColor, fonts, color-mix and timers all work. Attribute selectors only match with a namespace prefix, focus-visible is always false, ellipsis clips instead of fading, and no backend does backdrop-filter. The design system's CSS emitter and lint now encode these.
notes: Fallbacks adopted: [*|data-x] selectors, a data-modality attribute for focus rings, mask-image fades for truncation, compositor blur only.

entries.title: Local image generation runs: FLUX.2 Klein 4B on the 5070 Ti in 22 seconds
entries.lede: ComfyUI in a uv venv with a 2.6 GB quantised FLUX.2 Klein (Apache-2.0). The smoke prompt asked for a single flat object; the model returned a photograph, which is what the style brief and the squircle post-processing will correct. Qwen-Image-2512 waits for 13 GB of free VRAM.
